segments.performance: Small curious brow change on why would they bother with mine, then release. Direct gaze through Do they choose mine. A brief thought-related glance beside lens may accompany Maybe I’ve gotta build a bit more, returning for an easy That’s fine. No accusatory brow hold or shrug.

segments.start: But I’ve got other projects I wanna work on too
